name: name-constraints-both-empty-invalid
description: RFC 5280 4.2.1.10 requires that at least one of permittedSubtrees or excludedSubtrees be present, and that any present sequence be non-empty. A nameConstraints SEQUENCE { [0] SEQUENCE {} [1] SEQUENCE {} } violates the (1..MAX) constraint on GeneralSubtrees twice over and must be rejected.
notes: Distinct decode path from `empty-name-constraints-extension-invalid` (SEQUENCE {}) and `permitted-subtrees-empty-invalid` (single [0] {} only).
